versions.changelog:
Elite PPT Pro 0.1.0 — Initial Release

- Launch of an elite consulting-style PPT generator merging 7 color themes and 38 slide layouts.
- Enforces McKinsey-grade data-first workflow: minimum 15 data points, 5+ sources, mandatory source citations on every data slide.
- Strict design standards: max 2 accent colors per slide, conclusion-as-title rule, minimum 4 content areas per slide.
- Supports industry-standard frameworks and data-driven business presentations.
- Dual output: generates both .pptx (editable) and high-fidelity HTML preview.
- Includes detailed research, QA, and technical best practices for premium PPT creation.
